Subject: Weekly lane handoff + owners rotation — submission window & 15m alignment

Team — quick heads up for this week’s submission window (final turn-in: Thursday 16:00 PT). I’m consolidating owners and evidence before the EOD push — please read and action the bullets below: 

1) Owners rotation (see attached owners_rotation_matrix.pdf): I’ve assigned primary/backup for each close lane. If you cannot own your primary, reply ASAP so we can reassign.

2) Evidence roster (attached evidence_roster.csv): drop docs into the Drive folder linked below by Wednesday 18:00 PT. We need one of: contract, signed SOW, or PO for any >$50k line.

3) 15-minute alignment call: Wednesday 11:00–11:15 PT. Quick cadence: 3 min status, 7 min blockers, 5 min owner confirm + last-minute asks. Join link: https://meet.redwood.com/forecast-align (calendar invite sent).

4) Strawman commit guidance: use the "best-supported" number in HubSpot and tag any uncertain lines with "evidence-needed". I’ll run a short triage Thursday morning for anything flagged.

Please confirm your lane ownership in thread (reply with the deal short name you’re owning). I’ll publish the combined roster after the Wednesday call.

Attachments: owners_rotation_matrix.pdf (matrix), evidence_roster.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Avery
